data.html_description: Learn how rhythm in design creates visual flow, unity, and mood - and how to apply Regular, Alternating, Progressive, and Random rhythm in your work.
data.description: Listen to your favorite song and notice what happens in the first four bars. Before any lyrics land, before the melody hooks you, there is a pulse - a pattern of beats that tells your body it is safe to move.
